prompt:
Design a 1440x900 screenshot-style desktop app screen for BenchForge, a local C++ database benchmark with a C# control dashboard. This is the Semiconductor Test Traveler direction. Use a precise light mineral surface, ink-blue text, deep teal and oxide-orange state colors, thin square-edged input borders, printed test-sheet alignment marks used sparingly. It should feel like a modern engineering recipe sheet, not a generic SaaS admin dashboard, not beige stationery, not dark terminal, not a fake hardware control panel. No gradients, no photos, no decorative icons, no cards full of icons.

Exact composition: narrow header with only “BenchForge”; title “Configure a benchmark”; below, two columns: a form area about 70% wide and an empty Recent runs rail about 30%. Do not add navigation links, menus, or extra status widgets. The form is organized by literal labels: Adapter, Scenario, Run settings, Synthetic ID space, Operation mix. No section numbers; the fields are editable-looking native form controls. Put the “Start run” button at the bottom of the left form. In the right rail show only “No runs yet” and a short empty-state instruction, no fake rows.

The unique semiconductor test-traveler graphic is a 10-by-10 grid of exactly 100 small square cells inside Operation mix. The six operation colors occupy exactly 40, 25, 15, 10, 5, and 5 cells, respectively; each group has its operation name and percentage in a plain visible legend. Also show Total 100%. It is a static visualization of the configured synthetic operation weights, never live performance.

Only use these product facts: Adapter “noop — harness calibration”; Scenario radio choices exactly “Normal” (selected) and “Celebrity”; Workers 4; Warm-up (ms) 250; Duration (ms) 1000; Seed 42; Users 10,000; Posts 100,000; Follows 200,000; Hashtags 1,000. Operation weights: Timeline read 40%, Profile read 25%, Post like 15%, Post create 10%, Hashtag search 5%, Follow 5%. Show the note “Synthetic workload. No social app data.” and the accurate caveat “noop does not connect to a database; results measure harness overhead only.” Nothing else: no extra scenarios, adapters, result numbers, run identifiers, claims, or social-media content. Prioritize readable labels and exact values.
